text:
Elaine (CS): Hey team, Sundown dry-run finished 10m ago. Left a few items flagged by the infra test harness — posting here so we can triage before cutover tomorrow.

Jules (Customer): thanks Elaine — we ran the connectivity checklist from the playbook and saw a failure on audit-log delivery.

Ash (Net Eng): Confirming, egress to splunk-ingest.sundown-corp.com:443 was blocked from the priv-subnet. Security team applied a deny-all rule yesterday; can you paste the ENI/subnet CNAMES?

Jules (Customer): subnet-id: subnet-0a1b2c3d, ENI eni-07f4a9, we can open to that FQDN or to 3.12.45.67.

Mohit (Infra Eng): FYI the deploy logs also show KMS Decrypt errors when trying to unwrap the model keys: 

```
2024-04-10T14:22:03Z ERR KMS: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-deploy-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
```

Mohit (Infra Eng): Looks like the customer key policy hasn't granted the cross-account role. Jules, can you confirm the key policy includes the redwood-deploy-role principal?

Jules (Customer): we added a policy but maybe to the alias not the key. I'll check — one sec.

Samir (Platform): Also noticed the IAM role the customer provided uses an external ID that doesn't match what's in our template. If STS fails we'll get intermittent auth. This is also why the health test shows flapping.

Elaine (CS): Tagging renewal risk: if we can't get logs/KMS sorted before cutover we should delay final acceptance — finance has a renewal checkpoint in 2 weeks. I'd like to avoid that.

Ash (Net Eng): Action items: 1) Jules to add cidr egress to 3.12.45.67:443 or allow FQDN. 2) Jules to update KMS key policy to include: 

```
"Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-deploy-role" }
```

3) Jules to confirm IAM role external_id = "sundown-1708".

Jules (Customer): doing 1+2 now, external_id check next. ETA 30m.

Mohit (Infra Eng): Meanwhile I'll re-run the decrypt test with a fallback path. If KMS still denies, we can switch to a customer-provided wrapping key but that requires a short config change in the private runtime.

Samir (Platform): Quick note on observability — we had one doc gap in the onboarding guide around S3 lifecycle for audit logs (retention vs. access logs). Jules, do you want us to set the bucket policy and lifecycle for you?

Jules (Customer): yes please, that would help. We don't want logs older than 90 days unless flagged.

Elaine (CS): Good feedback — we'll capture that as an enablement doc update item. Jules, can you add any pain points you hit in a short bullet list? We'll surface to Product.

Jules (Customer): main points: (1) alias vs key policy diff was confusing, (2) external_id instructions could be clearer in the template, (3) playbook egress examples only show CIDR not FQDN.

Ash (Net Eng): Thanks — noted. I'll add a short FAQ section and an example `curl` test you can run from the bastion: 

```
curl -v https://splunk-ingest.sundown-corp.com:443/health -H "Host: splunk-ingest.sundown-corp.com"
```

Mohit (Infra Eng): Status update: re-run complete, KMS still denies until key policy updated. Audit logs queued but not delivered; will retry once egress opens.

DeployBot: deploy-checker: dry-run COMPLETE — 3 WARN, 2 FAIL. See https://redwood.internal/deploys/1708453210 for details.

Elaine (CS): OK — plan: Jules does 1+2 in 30m, we reconvene here at +45m. If resolved, Mohit and Samir will run final acceptance. If not, postpone cutover and log a renewal-risk incident.

Jules (Customer): done with key policy update and opened egress to 3.12.45.67. Re-testing now.

Ash (Net Eng): I see SYN/ACK from the splunk target now.

Mohit (Infra Eng): Decrypt test success ✅. Audit logs are flowing. Re-running final acceptance.

Samir (Platform): Final acceptance: PASS. Good job all. I'll annotate the account health score and mark low renewal risk for now.

Elaine (CS): Closing notes: capture Jules' feedback into the onboarding repo (issue created), adjust docs for alias vs key policy, external_id sample, and FQDN egress examples. Thanks everyone :tada:
